_comment: Evaluation set for the voice assistant (#32). Dates are relative to the run day in Singapore: today, yesterday, tomorrow, today-N, last-monday (the most recent Monday before today). expect.type is sales (entries must match exactly, and expect.closures if given; a sales case must not propose closed days), price (a price change for that dish, and unitCost when given), closure (closed-day changes only, matching expect.closures by date and closed), question (no proposal and no tour: the assistant should ask), refuse (no proposal and no tour), guide (a tour that highlights one of anyOf), link (page chat only: no proposal and no tour, and the reply links to one of the pages in anyOf), or any (only the global no-writes check applies). A dish starting with new: is a dish the account doesn't have. explain (no proposal and no tour; every number in the reply is one of the forecast's inputs: the forecast and its range from /api/forecast, history.sameWeekday, the dates' day numbers, or a small count; no forbid pattern (an invented cause, like "because of the rain") matches, and require matches if given). summary (no proposal and no tour; every number in the reply is in GET /api/summary/weekly's text, the week's portions among them, and require matches). Before the cases, history is recorded for its dish on the same weekday as its date in past weeks; cases with page "forecast" send that forecast as the one on screen. Optional audio: put a recording at audio/<id>.webm|m4a|wav|mp3 and it is transcribed instead of using text.
